scope: Derived from Google Search Console only (via seo-impact-latest.json and keywords-master.json). Competitor #1-blocker analysis and AI-visibility tracking are intentionally excluded here — they require manual research and are not auto-generated.
wins: Core local/national-authority cluster now anchored in the #2-3 tier: bariatric therapist (position 2.0, delta +1.5), weight loss therapist (position 2.0, delta +3.5), bariatric counseling (position 2.9, 23 impressions, delta +0.5), and bariatric surgery counseling (position 3.3, 14 impressions, delta +2.0) — all four holding top-3.

Biggest positive mover this run: 'weight loss counseling' jumped from position 31.8 to 8.6 (delta +23.2, 11 impressions), moving into the #4-10 tier; 'weight loss counseling or therapy' moved from 38.8 to 17.2 (delta +21.6).

Top-performing page remains /healthy-living-2/why-hydration-is-essential-for-weight-loss-and-management/ with 1,644 impressions, 10 clicks, and an average position of 5.0 — by far the strongest organic asset on the site.
The #2-3 tier held steady at 4 keywords versus the prior run (9/23), while the #4-10 tier grew from 5 to 6 keywords — modest upward pressure in the mid tiers even as overall impressions dipped.
needs_attention: 21 of 83 tracked KEYWORDS show any GSC impressions this run (down slightly from 22 of 83 on 9/23). This is a keyword count, not a page count — the other 62 keywords simply have no impressions yet; it does not mean 62 pages are missing or unpublished.

Keyword-tracker hygiene is largely clean: of 51 distinct target pages behind the 83 tracked keywords, only 1 (the 'what-is-a-bariatric-counselor' keyword) still points at a staging12 URL. Per the 2026-06-03 sitemap check, staging-targeted tracker URLs are most often stale pointers to pages already live under a different slug — a tracker-hygiene issue, not evidence of an unpublished page. We cannot see the staging site, so no unpublished-page count is asserted here.

Site-wide visibility has drifted down since the May baseline: impressions fell from 2,447 (5/7) to 1,158 (9/24), roughly -53%, with average position moving from 14.87 to 16.78 over the same span. The series is volatile (average position spiked past 30 in late June/July before recovering), and single-day, single-impression keyword positions swing day to day — read as directional only, not exact.

CTR remains near-zero across the board: 1,158 impressions produced only 3 clicks today (~0.3% CTR), consistent with the pattern all quarter. Several page-1-adjacent pages are getting found but not clicked — e.g. the Ozempic/Mounjaro/Zepbound comparison page at position 8.7 with 417 impressions and 0 clicks, and the gastroparesis page at position 9.7 with 226 impressions and 0 clicks.

Three commercial/local terms slipped with real impressions behind them: 'eating disorder treatment san antonio' (position 39.0, delta -18.0, 5 impressions), 'bariatric psychological evaluation near me' (position 45.2, delta -20.3, 6 impressions), and 'food addiction treatment' (position 56.6, delta -11.2, 7 impressions). These are low-impression positions that swing day to day and should be treated as directional signal, not precise rank.
priority_actions: Repoint the one stale staging targetUrl in keywords-master.json (the 'what-is-a-bariatric-counselor' keyword, currently staging12.bariatriccounselingcenter.com) to its correct live www URL so GSC can match it.

Add stronger CTAs and meta descriptions to high-impression, zero/low-click pages to convert visibility into clicks — start with the Ozempic vs Mounjaro vs Zepbound comparison page (417 impressions, 0 clicks) and the gastroparesis page (226 impressions, 0 clicks).

Defend the #2-3 core cluster (bariatric therapist, weight loss therapist, bariatric counseling, bariatric surgery counseling) with fresh internal links from the top-performing hydration article and the About page.

Run an on-page refresh/content review for the three slipped terms above, especially 'eating disorder treatment san antonio' and 'bariatric psychological evaluation near me', to rule out content drift or a technical issue on the targeted pages.
Add FAQ schema to service pages, prioritizing the near-zero-CTR pages, to improve rich-result and AI-overview eligibility.

If a staging→prod publish backlog matters here, confirm the real list via a staging-vs-prod sitemap diff or Daniel's own notes — GSC and keyword-tracker data cannot honestly produce an unpublished-page count.
summary: Day-over-day average position improved slightly (17.23 → 16.78) even as impressions dipped, with the core #2-3 local/national cluster holding steady and 'weight loss counseling' posting the quarter's biggest single-keyword gain (+23.2 positions); the main structural issue remains near-zero click-through on impression-heavy pages, not a coverage or publishing problem.
